pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: The dark regions exhibit complex, non-geometric polygonal shapes with highly irregular, serrated, and stellate (star-like) edges. These patches show high-frequency pixel oscillations along their boundaries, creating a 'toothed' appearance against the lighter background. Relative spatial area of patches is greatest on the upper flank and becomes more fragmented with smaller surface area towards the hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored negative space forms a continuous, interconnected lattice. Intersection nodes are primarily tri-point and quadri-point junctions where three or four dark patches converge. Pixel thickness of these pathways is highly variable, constricting at the sharp vertices of adjacent patches and expanding at major topological nodes.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck and shoulder presents a dense, short-haired silhouette with a fine, high-frequency serrated contour. The amplitude of the individual hair clusters is low and relatively consistent across the visible 1D profile against the overexposed background.
